_doc: Settlements. A Node is your AI's settlement; a city belongs to a homeworld faction until someone takes it. Both work the hexes within workRadius (Civ-style), supply Energy to whoever holds them, and can train units. When no unit defends a settlement, its walls fight (rules.json walls). Art: Node = structure_ai-node_stage<n>.png; city = structure_city-<culture>_stage<n>.png (64x64).
